en.headline: Jason Poon and wife charged over alleged $6m Covid loan fraud
en.dek: Police said the couple each face a fraud count and jointly four money-laundering counts over a 100 per cent government-guaranteed SME loan, with a first hearing on Monday.
body: Police said on Friday that a 56-year-old man surnamed Poon and a 54-year-old woman surnamed Chu have been charged with fraud and money laundering over an alleged $6 million deception involving the government's 100 per cent Guarantee Product under the SME Financing Guarantee Scheme.

Multiple local newsrooms identified the defendants as construction businessman and China Technology Monitor chairman Jason Poon Cheuk-hung and his wife, Chu Shui-fong. Police said each has been charged with one count of fraud, and that they jointly face four counts of dealing with property known or believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence. The case is due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts on the morning of 28 September.

Six people, including the company directors and four staff aged 31 to 53, were arrested on 18 March on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud. Police have alleged that, while applying for the loan between April and June 2021 in the name of a surgical-mask manufacturer, the group submitted false sales figures and inflated salary records so the application would qualify.
The pair have not yet entered a plea. They are accused, not convicted, and the allegations will be tested in court.

zh.headline: 潘煌鴻夫婦被控涉欺詐600萬元百分百擔保貸款
zh.dek: 警方指兩人各被控一項欺詐罪，合共四項洗黑錢罪，案件周一在九龍城裁判法院首次提堂。
body: 警方周五表示，一名56歲姓潘男子及一名54歲姓朱女子，已各被落案起訴一項欺詐罪，並合共被控四項處理已知道或相信為代表從可公訴罪行得益的財產罪，涉及政府中小企融資擔保計劃「百分百擔保特惠貸款」一筆600萬元貸款。
多間本地傳媒指兩名被告為建築工程商人、中科監察主席潘煌鴻及其妻子朱瑞芳。案件定於9月28日上午在九龍城裁判法院提堂。
今年3月18日，包括公司董事夫婦及四名31至53歲員工在內共六人，涉嫌串謀詐騙被捕。警方指集團於2021年4月至6月以一間外科口罩製造商名義申請貸款期間，涉嫌提交虛假銷售額及誇大薪金紀錄，以符合申請資格。
兩人尚未答辯。他們現時只是被控，並非已被定罪，控罪須由法庭審理。
